sobs_chart_configs.Title: Trace volume
sobs_chart_configs.Query:
SELECT
  time,
  ServiceName AS service,
  SignalSource AS source,
  SignalName AS signal,
  AttrFingerprint AS attr_fp,
  value,
  SampleCount AS sample_count,
  baseline_mean,
  baseline_lower,
  baseline_upper,
  anomaly_state,
  anomaly_score
FROM v_derived_signals_anomaly
WHERE ServiceName = (
  SELECT ServiceName
  FROM v_derived_signals_anomaly
  WHERE SignalSource = 'traces' AND SignalName = 'trace_volume'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
  AND SignalSource = 'traces'
  AND SignalName = 'trace_volume'
  AND time >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
ORDER BY time
